purpose: Allocate a blank query-term return ledger for the twenty semantic-slot query templates so future dated non-personal query-term approvals can be received before query strings, service selection, service execution, or result capture.

refined_active_lane.lane_name: relation/function semantic-slot query-term return ledger template
refined_active_lane.result: Twenty blank query-term return rows were allocated and linked to eighty-six service-option rows, six capture-policy return rows, and eight candidate-family rows.

query_term_boundary.ledger_template_is: blank future return ledger for query-term authority returns
allowed_now: allocate blank query-term return fields per semantic slot
link query-term blanks to capture-policy return blanks and service-option rows
mark every service option locked until both query-term and capture-policy returns exist
keep terminology, query, result, evidence, source-text, surface, and translation fields empty
blocked_now: choosing service routes as active query routes
capturing entries, corpus rows, definitions, examples, equivalent rows, or output text
opening evidence, surface, translation, or pilot gates

query_term_return_template_rows.semantic_slot_label: partial order or poset structure slot
inverse operation or inverse relation slot

affected_candidate_family_query_term_row.candidate_area: function property family: one-to-one, onto, injective, surjective, bijective
equivalence relation, partial order, and poset family
relation properties: reflexive, symmetric, antisymmetric, transitive
high-density DMOI relation/function source files as future packet shelves

next_valid_artifacts.trigger: dated non-personal query-term authority returns exist
next_valid_artifacts.gate_effect: query-term return intake only; no service query execution or result capture

next_valid_artifacts.trigger: both query-term returns and finalized capture-policy returns exist
next_valid_artifacts.gate_effect: service query log/result metadata only; no accepted term, surface, translation, or pilot claim

decision: This package prevents query-term approval from being conflated with query execution. No term is approved, no query string is built, and no service or translation gate opens.
